# Engineering

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-skill-metadata.py from SKILL.md frontmatter. -->

- **[clean](./clean/SKILL.md)** — Review code for clean naming conventions — descriptive, intention-revealing names. Use when the user invokes /clean or asks for a clean code naming review.
- **[ddd](./ddd/SKILL.md)** — Review code against Domain-Driven Design aggregate rules. Use when the user invokes /ddd or asks for a DDD aggregate review.
- **[graphite](./graphite/SKILL.md)** — Split branch work into a logical Graphite PR stack. Use when the user invokes /graphite.
- **[onboard](./onboard/SKILL.md)** — Produce a concise onboarding doc for the current codebase. Use when the user invokes /onboard or says "onboard me to this codebase".
- **[oop](./oop/SKILL.md)** — Review code against principles from Elegant Objects by Yegor Bugayenko. Use when the user invokes /oop or asks for an elegant objects review.
- **[pre-pr-review](./pre-pr-review/SKILL.md)** — Use after a feature is complete and before opening a PR in any sibling. Repo-specific lint only — then runs ponytail-review, then loops thermo-nuclear-code-quality-review (via the loop skill) until the maintainability audit comes back clean. Triggers: feature complete, user says "open a PR", "pre-PR check", "review my changes", or before invoking gh pr create.
- **[rate](./rate/SKILL.md)** — Rate the current branch diff (1-5) against clean code, DDD, OOP, and idiomatic principles. Use when the user invokes /rate.
- **[scale](./scale/SKILL.md)** — Analyze branch code for scale limits, upgrade paths, system design diagrams, and learning resources. Use when the user invokes /scale.
- **[thermo-nuclear-code-quality-review](./thermo-nuclear-code-quality-review/SKILL.md)** — Run a required Greptile CLI first-pass gate followed by an extremely strict maintainability review for abstraction quality, giant files, and spaghetti-condition growth. Use for a pre-PR review, thermo-nuclear code quality review, thermonuclear review, deep code quality audit, or especially harsh maintainability review.
- **[webmcp-bridge](./webmcp-bridge/SKILL.md)** — Use when an external Playwright, Codex, Claude Code, or browser harness must generate, import, and invoke page-specific tools through the generic WebMCP Chrome extension.
